title: 第5章  喝酒
slug: 爹仙尊娘魔尊我嘎嘎乱杀
content_zh:
谢莲心忍不住怼了：“师叔，师尊已经处置过了，您要是不满的话，您跟我师尊说去吧。”
“你……”
韩素雪怒气冲上头，眼中隐隐有杀机爆开，周身冷意逼人，地面都开始咔嚓咔嚓地结冰了。柳如烟脸色苍白，一副受惊模样，心中却隐隐期待着谢莲心倒霉。
忽地春风拂面而过，冰消雪融了。
苏珩挡在了谢莲心面前，韩素雪面露惊愕，苏珩侧身低头问谢莲心：“莲心仙子，你刚刚说玄天宗有几个地方景色甚是不错，要带我看看的，你忘记了吗？”
谢莲心马上说：“哦，差点忘记了。”
“韩道友先告辞了。”苏珩微微笑，笑容无可挑剔。
谢莲心将桌上的古籍收入了储物袋里，苏珩身上青色遁光涌现，那青色遁光将谢莲心一卷，两人化为一道青色长虹就在原地消失了。
韩素雪面容更冷了，眼中有恨意。
小贱人，跟她母亲一样惯会勾引男人。
不过是片刻时间，就让苏珩主动帮她解围了，这勾引男人的手段就是遗传了独孤静那女人的吧？
————
奇峰险峻，一派白虹从悬崖坠落，千寻雪浪飞。
忽地，一道青色遁光从天而降，落在一处青石之上，变成了一个青衣的男子和一个白衣的少女。
青衣男子朗如玉山，清如秋水，少女虽然年纪尚幼，然雪肤花貌，已经能看得出是个绝色美人胚子了。
“你韩师叔不喜欢你吗？”苏珩笑着问谢莲心。
“她不喜欢的人可多了，不止我一个。就是不知道为什么，特别喜欢挑我的刺。”谢莲心道。
前世她也疑惑，后面她知道了，原来这家伙暗恋她爹，还恨极了她母亲。
“我帮你解围，你怎么谢我？”苏珩问。
“你堂堂仙君这么小气的吗？这样都跟我要好处啊？”谢莲心道。

她才不怕韩素雪呢，也不信韩素雪真的敢对她如何。
“开玩笑的。”苏珩道。
谢莲心望着他的脸，又说：“好吧，好吧，算你帮我忙了，我带你去个好地方吧。走，跟我来！”
说完，她就化为了一道红色流光朝着一处方向飞去了。苏珩见状，好奇地化为一道青色流光跟在了她的身后。
谢莲心带着苏珩飞出了昆山主脉，来到了主脉的一处偏僻的山峰，又落在了半山腰的一处山洞。这山洞中生长着许多绚丽夺目的花草，里面还有一股灵泉，灵气边上有一株高达几十丈的灵樱树，树上开满了粉色的花。
树下有桌椅，谢莲心朝着树下走去，拿起了倚靠在树上的锄头，就在树下一挖，她挖出了两坛子酒出来。
“酒？”苏珩很惊讶。
“嗯，我酿制的酒，我请你喝酒。”谢莲心笑着说。
苏珩：“你才十四吧，你师尊让你喝酒？”
谢莲心道：“当然不让了，不然我至于藏到这里吗？”
苏珩：“……”
谢莲心已经将酒坛子倒满了。
“来来来，喝酒。”谢莲心笑着坐下了。
苏珩没有坐，他半开玩笑道：“我要是跟你喝酒，玉阳仙尊知道了，会不会追杀我？”
“他追杀你，你不会逃吗？”谢莲心说。
苏珩愣了一下，旋即大笑起来：“莲心仙子果然是个妙人啊！”
他终于在谢莲心对面坐下了，端起了酒碗，尝了一口。
“怎么样？如何？”
“好酒。”
谢莲心豪迈地端起酒碗：“干杯！”

她生下来就酒量绝佳，大约因为一半不是人类的缘故吧。三岁就偷父亲谢逸的酒喝，喝得小脸通红，吓到了谢逸，然后谢逸就将整个玉阳峰的酒都给藏到不知道哪里去了。
苏珩笑着跟谢莲心碰了碰酒碗，喝了几碗之后，他笑着跟谢莲心说：“仙子海量，不过以后现在还是不要随便请陌生男人喝酒的好，特别是孤男寡女的时候。”
谢莲心紫瞳犀利地看着他：
“你以为我是傻瓜吗？这可是玄天宗范围内，我师尊的眼皮子底下。如果有人敢在我师尊眼皮子底下对我做什么，他就是个白痴。以我跟你这实力差距，要是你有什么坏心思，还需要等我喝醉酒吗？”
苏珩深深地看了她几眼，笑道：“莲心仙子还真是跟一般女子不同呢。”
谢莲心认真地说：
“你这话说错了，每一个女子都不同。我不是跟一般的女子不同，是所有的女子跟其他女子都是不同的。”
苏珩愣了愣，拱手道：“受教了。”
谢莲心轻轻地笑了，笑容若徐徐绽放的莲花。
苏珩注视着她的脸，碧色眼眸中似有波澜。忽地，感应到了什么，他起身道：“我该走了，多谢仙子的酒，后会有期！”
他礼貌地拱手，说完化为了一道青色流光射出了洞口，一下子就消失在了云海之上了。
他走了之后，谢莲心继续将剩下的酒喝完了。接着她慢悠悠地从储物袋里，拿出了炼金傀儡的回路草稿，又细细地研究起来。
————
谢莲心研究傀儡的时候，韩素雪来到了玉阳峰，跟谢逸喝茶。
莲池旁边的水阁里，韩素雪和谢逸相对而坐，旁边还有一个柳如烟。
韩素雪端起一杯茶，轻轻地小啜了一口，脸上带着微笑。她面对谢逸的时候，脸上总是带着笑容的，眼中的含情脉脉更是藏也藏不住。
“我走的时候，烟儿还是个小丫头，这一转眼啊，都成大姑娘了。这些年来，真是辛苦师兄了。要是柳兄和若眉妹妹看到如今的烟儿，必然欣慰无比。”韩素雪说着看了眼柳如烟。
柳如烟坐在一旁，露出了羞涩的模样。
“如烟是个乖巧的孩子，不需要我太费心。”谢逸道。
柳如烟听谢逸夸奖自己，白皙秀丽的面容之上，顿时浮现了一抹绯红。

韩素雪没有注意到柳如烟望着谢逸的目光，不然她定知道柳如烟看谢逸的眼神不清白。
她望着谢逸俊美的脸，从她第一眼看到他就已经情根深种了，可是他的眼中没有任何女人。当年不知道多少的女修爱慕他，却无一人能走进他的心里。
如果一直这样也就罢了，可偏偏，偏偏那个贱人……
想到这里，韩素雪就恨啊！
content_en:
Xie Lianxin couldn't help but said: "Uncle Master, Master has already dealt with it. If you are dissatisfied, you can tell me about it."
"You..."
Han Suxue was furious, and there was a faint murderous intent in her eyes. Her whole body was so cold that the ground began to freeze. Liu Ruyan's face was pale and frightened, but she was secretly expecting Xie Lianxin to be unlucky.
Suddenly the spring breeze blew by, the ice melted and the snow melted.
Su Heng stood in front of Xie Lianxin. Han Suxue looked shocked. Su Heng turned sideways and lowered her head and asked Xie Lianxin: "Fairy Lianxin, you just said that Xuantian Sect has several places with very good scenery that you want to show me. Have you forgotten?"
Xie Lianxin immediately said: "Oh, I almost forgot."
"Fellow Daoist Han, I'll take my leave first." Su Heng smiled slightly, his smile impeccable.
Xie Lianxin put the ancient books on the table into her storage bag. A cyan light emerged from Su Heng's body. The cyan light swept Xie Lianxin, and the two of them turned into a cyan rainbow and disappeared on the spot.
Han Suxue's face turned colder, with hatred in her eyes.
The little bitch is as good at seducing men as her mother.
It only took a moment for Su Heng to take the initiative to help her out. This method of seducing men was inherited from the woman Dugu Jing, right?
————
The peaks are steep, a white rainbow falls from the cliff, and thousands of snow waves fly.
Suddenly, a ray of blue light fell from the sky, landed on a bluestone, and turned into a man in blue and a girl in white.
The man in green clothes is as bright as a jade mountain and as clear as autumn water. Although the girl is still young, she can already tell that she is a stunning beauty with her snowy skin and beautiful face.
"Uncle Han, don't you like you?" Su Heng asked Xie Lianxin with a smile.
"There are many people she doesn't like, and I'm not the only one. She just doesn't know why, but she especially likes to pick on me." Xie Lian said in her heart.
She was also confused in her previous life, but later she found out that this guy had a crush on her father and hated her mother.
"I helped you out, how can you thank me?" Su Heng asked.
"Are you, the Immortal Lord, so stingy? Are you doing this to benefit me?" Xie Lian asked in her heart.
She is not afraid of Han Suxue, and she doesn't believe that Han Suxue really dares to do anything to her.
"You're kidding." Su Heng said.
Xie Lianxin looked at his face and said: "Okay, okay, you can help me, I'll take you to a good place. Come on, follow me!"
After saying that, she turned into a stream of red light and flew in a certain direction. Seeing this, Su Heng curiously turned into a stream of cyan light and followed her.
Xie Lianxin took Su Heng and flew out of the main line of Kunshan, arrived at a remote peak in the main line, and landed in a cave halfway up the mountain. There are many dazzling flowers and plants growing in this cave, and there is a spiritual spring inside. Next to the spiritual energy, there is a spiritual cherry tree dozens of feet high, which is full of pink flowers.
There were tables and chairs under the tree. Xie Lianxin walked towards the tree, picked up the hoe that was leaning on the tree, and dug under the tree. She dug out two jars of wine.
"Wine?" Su Heng was surprised.
"Well, I'll treat you to the wine I brewed." Xie Lianxin said with a smile.
Su Heng: "You are only fourteen, is your master asking you to drink?"
Xie Lian thought: "Of course I won't let it go, otherwise I would hide here?"
Su Heng: "..."
Xie Lianxin has already filled the wine jar.
"Come on, let's drink." Xie Lianxin smiled and sat down.
Su Heng did not sit down, he said half-jokingly: "If I drink with you and Immortal Yuyang knows about it, will he chase me down?"
"He is chasing you, won't you run away?" Xie Lianxin said.
Su Heng was stunned for a moment, then burst into laughter: "Fairy Lianxin is indeed a wonderful person!"
He finally sat down opposite Xie Lianxin, picked up the wine bowl, and took a sip.
"How? How?"
"Good wine."
Xie Lianxin held up the wine bowl boldly: "Cheers!"
She was born with a great capacity for drinking, probably because half of her body is not humanBecause of the class. When he was three years old, he stole wine from his father Xie Yi and drank until his face turned red. Xie Yi was frightened. Then Xie Yi hid all the wine in Yuyang Peak somewhere.
Su Heng smiled and clinked the wine bowls with Xie Lianxin. After drinking a few bowls, he smiled and said to Xie Lianxin: "There are a lot of fairies, but it is better not to invite random men to drink from now on, especially when you are alone."
Xie Lianxin's purple eyes looked at him sharply:
"Do you think I'm a fool? This is within the scope of Xuantian Sect, under my master's nose. If anyone dares to do anything to me under my master's nose, he is an idiot. With the gap in strength between you and me, if you have any bad intentions, do you still need to wait for me to get drunk?"
Su Heng looked at her deeply and said with a smile: "Fairy Lianxin is really different from other women."
Xie Lianxin said seriously:
"What you said is wrong. Every woman is different. I am not different from ordinary women, but all women are different from other women."
Su Heng was stunned for a moment, then cupped his hands and said, "I've been taught a lesson."
Xie Lianxin smiled softly, her smile like a slowly blooming lotus.
Su Heng stared at her face, and there seemed to be waves in his green eyes. Suddenly, he sensed something, and he stood up and said, "It's time for me to go. Thanks to the fairy for the wine. See you later!"
He politely handed over his hand, and after saying that, he turned into a stream of cyan light and shot out of the hole, disappearing above the sea of clouds.
After he left, Xie Lianxin continued to drink the remaining wine. Then she slowly took out the circuit draft of the alchemy puppet from her storage bag and studied it carefully.
————
While Xie Lianxin was studying the puppets, Han Suxue came to Yuyang Peak and drank tea with Xie Yi.
In the water pavilion next to the lotus pond, Han Suxue and Xie Yi sat opposite each other, with Liu Ruyan next to them.
Han Suxue picked up a cup of tea and took a sip with a smile on her face. When she faced Xie Yi, she always had a smile on her face, and the affection in her eyes couldn't be hidden.
"When I left, Yan'er was still a little girl. In the blink of an eye, she became a big girl. It's been really hard for me, senior brother, over the years. If Brother Liu and Sister Ruomei see Yan'er today, they will be extremely happy." Han Suxue said and glanced at Liu Ruyan.
Liu Ruyan sat aside, looking shy.
"Ruyan is a well-behaved child, so I don't need to worry too much." Xie Yi said.
When Liu Ruyan heard Xie Yi praise herself, a blush suddenly appeared on her fair and beautiful face.
Han Suxue didn't notice the way Liu Ruyan looked at Xie Yi, otherwise she would have known that Liu Ruyan looked at Xie Yi with unclear eyes.
She looked at Xie Yi's handsome face. She had been deeply in love with him since the first time she saw him, but there was no woman in his eyes. I don't know how many female cultivators admired him back then, but no one could get into his heart.
It would be fine if it had always been like this, but that bitch...
Thinking of this, Han Suxue hated it!
